findings.summary: Changing the type assertion from obj.(Mock) to obj.(*Mock) means a Mock value passed to AssertExpectationsForObjects falls through to the unchecked assertExpectationser assertion and panics, since Mock (value) doesn't implement the pointer-receiver interface.
A *Mock passed directly now matches the deprecated branch and logs a spurious deprecation notice even though it is valid, non-deprecated use.
The old by-value copy of Mock now copies the mutex (go vet copylocks); the by-value branch should be dropped or handled without copying.
Any other place that copies a Mock by value will now trigger a go vet copylocks warning; vet and tests weren't run.
